degree_rationale: Sets out the five primal Faces of Light (First Man, Ambassador, Jesus, Great Counsel, Spirit-of-Life) with their five Counterparts in Darkness. Essence-mapping of the principal cosmic agents.
direction_rationale: The originating five Faces, set forth as foundational players of the cosmic drama. Like the rising of the cardinal cosmic visages.
grand_man_function: The five primal Faces — the celestial fivefold of countenance from which the cosmos is engaged.
title: The Five Intellectual Faces of Light versus the Five of Darkness
